content: Cefuroxime, marketed under the brand name ZINACEF, should be stored in its dry state at a temperature range of 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F) and must be protected from exposure to light. The 5-gram ADD-Vantage vials, supplied in trays of 10, are specifically designed to be used exclusively with Abbott ADD-Vantage diluent containers. When ZINACEF is provided as a premixed frozen solution of cefuroxime injection, it must be stored at temperatures not exceeding -20°C to maintain its stability. Additionally, the 5-gram plastic containers, supplied in cartons of 24, are equivalent to cefuroxime in terms of active content.
